column1: # Words Tamil speakers routinely write in Tamil script but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from the Tamil phonetic rules: English spelling says
# little about English sound, so "school" would come out ச்சூல் and "phone"
# பொனே. Typed on the Tamil phonetic layout, the English spelling on the left
# resolves directly to the Tamil form on the right, ahead of the rules and of
# A hand-written draft that wants a Tamil speaker's review. A wrong entry here
# is worse than a missing one, since it outranks everything. Where Tamil writes
# a loan two ways (ஃப்ரெண்ட் / பிரண்டு), the commoner chat form comes first.
# Format: english<TAB>tamil   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
